question: Záhradní trpaslíci s červenou čiapkou strážia nejednu slovenskú predzáhradku. V ktorej krajine ich ako prví začali vyrábať vo veľkom?
source_excerpt: Gräfenroda, a Thuringian village with a ceramics tradition, where two firms founded in 1872 later set up mass and serial gnome production

extra.why_interesting: Every Slovak has seen gnomes in front gardens but never wondered where they come from. Many players would guess somewhere fairy-tale-like or English. Germany is reachable by reasoning (fairy tales, Thuringian forests, ceramics), and the backstory is a nice reward.
extra.verification_notes: Garden gnomes were first mass-produced in Germany (Gräfenroda, Thuringia, 19th century); sources differ on dates and firms but all are German; see https://en.wikipedia.com/wiki/Lawn_gnome

explanation: Prvé keramické trpaslíky vyrábali v durínskom mestečku Gräfenroda. Inšpirovali sa nemeckými povesťami o škriatkoch, ktorí v horách strážia poklady a pomáhajú baníkom.

question: V ktorom poľskom meste sa po uliciach, pri lampách a na parapetoch skrývajú stovky malých bronzových trpaslíkov, ktorých turisti hľadajú ako poklad?
source_excerpt: As of 2026, the number of dwarves in the city is estimated at around 1,040.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks often visit nearby Poland, and many have heard of the dwarf-hunting city or can reason their way to a big Polish tourist city. The payoff is that these cute figures began as a protest against the communist regime, a story Slovaks connect with from their own history.
extra.verification_notes: Wrocław's bronze krasnale (dwarfs) are scattered across the city and number about 1,040 as of 2026 per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wroc%C5%82aw_Dwarfs, so the answer still holds.

explanation: Trpaslíci odkazujú na hnutie Pomarančová alternatíva. Jeho členovia za komunizmu kreslili trpaslíkov na miesta, kde úrady zatreli protirežimné nápisy, a tak si z cenzúry robili žarty.
